Alyssa: quick heads-up — search is returning 404s for a bunch of ja runtime pages (noticed from user feedback). Example: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/ja/runtime/kv-cache (returns 404). Anyone seen this pattern before?
Mike: yep, that's usually the CDN redirect map not including the localized slug.
Nina: I can take a look. Is the expected fix to add a redirect rule or update frontmatter on the pages?
Sam: if the canonical path changed, frontmatter owner + canonical should be set, but the quick mitigation is adding a redirect entry in redirect-rules.json for /ja/* -> /ja/<path>.
DocsBot: LinkHealth scan (run at 2026-03-20T02:15Z) flagged 37 ja pages with 404s — report: https://internal.docs/report/2739 (automated).
Alyssa: Nina — if you can add frontmatter owner and confirm the file exists in the ja tree, i'll trigger a quick reroute after the PR merges. smaller blast if we avoid touching global redirect rules. :thumbsup:
Nina: ok taking it. first step: grep to find missing frontmatter locale entries. running: `rg "^locale: ja" content/ja/runtime -n`
Mike: FYI EngInfra prefers a single redirect patch when many pages are affected. pinging @EngInfra so they know we might request a CDN rule change if it's widespread.
EngInfra: noted — if you open an infra-ticket with a short list of affected slugs we can add a temporary prefix redirect while the docs PRs roll in.
Nina: found ~12 pages missing `locale: ja` in frontmatter under content/ja/runtime. I'll add myself as owner and push small PRs (one commit per file).
Sam: can you also include a tiny CI check in the PR that fails when `locale` is missing for files under content/ja? e.g., `scripts/test_i18n_frontmatter.sh` — we added a template test a while back.
Nina: good call — will add the test as part of the same PR so future misses fail fast.
Alyssa: perfect. pls tag me in the PR and i'll run the search reindex job after merge. if the redirect rule is still needed we'll escalate to EngInfra ticket.
Nina: creating PR now — link coming in a minute (will list changed files in the PR description).
Mike: thanks — I can take follow-up to batch apply redirect-rules if EngInfra asks for the list.
Alyssa: awesome, appreciate the quick turn. keeping this thread for updates.
Nina: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/8421 — includes frontmatter fixes + test. requesting review from Mike and Sam.
Sam: reviewing now. small nit: please use `locale: ja` (lowercase) — our parser is case-sensitive.
Nina: fixed and pushed. CI green on the test.
Alyssa: merging after Sam's quick ✅. i'll reindex and report back with search fix status. :rocket:
